pdf.extract_text.use_when: The person wants to know what a PDF says, or wants something read or summarised from one.
examples: read the boarding pass pdf and tell me my seat
pull the text out of my tax return pdf
not_for: how do I make a pdf

pdf.ocr.use_when: The person has a scanned PDF and wants the text in it read.
examples: this pdf is a scan, can you read it
get the text from the scanned contract
